# VARIABLES

```{sh}
TEMPDIR="$HOME/temp_AIVms"
mkdir -p $TEMPDIR
export PATH="$PATH:$HOME/seqtk"
module load parallel/20210622-GCCcore-10.3.0


module load Anaconda3
source activate famsa

```

## Preparation

```{sh}

# install missing fasttree
wget http://www.microbesonline.org/fasttree/FastTree -O fasttree
chmod +x fasttree

# install missing gotree
wget https://github.com/evolbioinfo/gotree/releases/download/v0.4.5/gotree_v0.4.5_amd64_linux -O gotree
chmod +x gotree

# install seqtk for fasta processing
git clone https://github.com/lh3/seqtk.git;
cd seqtk; make ; cd

# install FAMSA
module load Anaconda3
conda create -n famsa
source activate famsa
conda install -c conda-forge libstdcxx-ng=12
conda install bioconda::famsa
conda install bioconda::cd-hit
 
# install TrimAl
conda install bioconda::trimal

# instal seqkit (for deduplication
conda install seqkit

```

# Metadata 

```{sh}
# Table ID and sequence name
for file in $TEMPDIR/African_H5_Avian_27052024.fa $TEMPDIR/GISAID_HPAI_NAmerica_05042024.fasta $TEMPDIR/GISAID_H5SequenceAvian_04102024.fa $TEMPDIR/USA_H5_Animal_27052024.fa; do
  cat $file | fgrep '>' | sed 's/\r$//'| awk -F"|" '{print $5 "\t" $2}' | sort | uniq -c | awk '{if($1>=8) print $2 "\t" $3}' 
done | sort | uniq > $TEMPDIR/temp_Metadata.txt
sed -i 's/(//g' $TEMPDIR/temp_Metadata.txt 
sed -i 's/)//g' $TEMPDIR/temp_Metadata.txt 


```


# Fasta Prep

```{sh}

# length check
sed 's/\r$//' $TEMPDIR/GISAID_H5SequenceAvian_04102024.fa | perl $HOME/LenCutter.pl - > $TEMPDIR/full_raw.fa
sed 's/\r$//' $TEMPDIR/GISAID_HPAI_NAmerica_05042024.fasta | perl $HOME/LenCutter.pl - >> $TEMPDIR/full_raw.fa
sed 's/\r$//' $TEMPDIR/USA_H5_Animal_27052024.fa | perl $HOME/LenCutter.pl - >> $TEMPDIR/full_raw.fa
sed 's/\r$//' $TEMPDIR/African_H5_Avian_27052024.fa | perl $HOME/LenCutter.pl - >> $TEMPDIR/full_raw.fa

# change header name to ID_Segment
cat $TEMPDIR/full_raw.fa | awk -F"|" '/^>/ {print ">" $5 "_" $3; next} 1' > $TEMPDIR/simpleNames.fa
sed -i 's/EPI_ISL_/EPIISL/' $TEMPDIR/simpleNames.fa

# clean out non IUPAC
perl $HOME/fastaNucCleaner.pl $TEMPDIR/simpleNames.fa > $TEMPDIR/clean.fa
# deduplicate
awk '/^>/ {printf("%s%s\t",(N>0?"\n":""),$0);N++;next;} {printf("%s",$0);} END {printf("\n");}' $TEMPDIR/clean.fa | sort -t$'\t' -k1,1 -u | tr "\t" "\n" > $TEMPDIR/distinct.fa

# split ( and deduplicate)
mkdir -p $TEMPDIR/singleGeno
cat $TEMPDIR/distinct.fa | fgrep '>' | awk -F"_" '{print $1}' | sed 's/>//' | sort | uniq | while read line; do
  NAME=`echo $line`
  echo $NAME
  OUT=`echo $TEMPDIR/singleGeno/${NAME}.fa`
  fgrep "${line}_" $TEMPDIR/distinct.fa | sed 's/>//g' | sort | uniq > $TEMPDIR/tempNames.txt
  seqtk subseq $TEMPDIR/distinct.fa $TEMPDIR/tempNames.txt | awk '/^>/{if(N>0) printf("\n"); ++N; printf("%s\t",$0);next;} {printf("%s",$0);}END{printf("\n");}' |sort -k1,1 -u | tr '\t' '\n' > $OUT
done

# check if all files contain 8 segments
# make a list of files
fgrep '>' $TEMPDIR/singleGeno/*fa | awk -F":" '{print $1}' | sort | uniq -c | awk '{if($1 == 8) print $2}' > ${TEMPDIR}/nomiFasta.txt
# remove others (double entries, 16 segments)
ls $TEMPDIR/singleGeno/*fa | fgrep -vf ${TEMPDIR}/nomiFasta.txt | while read line; do rm $line; done

# make list with good samples for analysis
ls $HOME/temp_AIVms/singleGeno/*.fa | while read line; do NOME=`basename $line .fa | sed 's/EPIISL/EPI_ISL_/'`; echo $NOME; done > $HOME/temp_AIVms/analizedSamples.txt


```


## US Classification

genin2 v.2.1.3
https://github.com/USDA-VS/GenoFLU

```{sh}

conda create -n GenoFLu2 python=3.10 -c conda-forge -y
source activate GenoFLu2

conda install importlib_resources -c conda-forge -y
cd $TEMPDIR
git clone https://github.com/izsvenezie-virology/genin2
cd genin2

```

```{sh}
module load Anaconda3
source activate GenoFLu

# genotype using GenoFlu$
mkdir -p $TEMPDIR/genoflu_out
# because of bad programming, needs to be run in folder with fasta, only one after the other
cd $TEMPDIR/singleGeno/
sbatch --ntasks=1 --cpus-per-task=1 $TEMPDIR/submissionUSA.sh
cd

# merge US class
find "$TEMPDIR/genoflu_out" -maxdepth 1 -name 'USclass_*.tsv' | while read line; do awk -F"\t" '{print $3 "\t" $4}' $line | fgrep 'File Name'; done | head -n1 > $TEMPDIR/US_classification.txt
find "$TEMPDIR/genoflu_out" -maxdepth 1 -name 'USclass_*.tsv' | while read line; do awk -F"\t" '{print $3 "\t" $4}' $line | fgrep -v 'File Name'; done >> $TEMPDIR/US_classification.txt

```

## distance matrix

```{sh}
source activate famsa

# split up into fasta for each segment
mkdir -p $TEMPDIR/eachSeg
rm $TEMPDIR/eachSeg/*
for SEG in HA MP NA NP NS PA PB1 PB2; do
  fgrep "_$SEG" $TEMPDIR/clean.fa | sort | uniq | sed 's/>//' > $TEMPDIR/eachSeg/tempNames
  seqtk subseq $TEMPDIR/clean.fa $TEMPDIR/eachSeg/tempNames > $TEMPDIR/eachSeg/Segment_$SEG.fa
done

# calculate distance
ls $TEMPDIR/eachSeg/Segment_*.fa > $TEMPDIR/fileToAlign.txt
sbatch --ntasks=1 --cpus-per-task=20 $TEMPDIR/submissionALN.sh
#Segment_NP.DistMatrix


# cluster each trimmed sequence
for SEG in HA MP NA NP NS PA PB1 PB2; do
  sed 's/-//g' $TEMPDIR/Segment_${SEG}_trimmed.aln > $TEMPDIR/eachSeg/Segment_${SEG}_trimmed.fa
done

for SEG in HA MP NA NP NS PA PB1 PB2; do
  sbatch --job-name="Ref_clust" --mem-per-cpu=50G --cpus-per-task=10 --wrap "cd-hit-est -i $TEMPDIR/eachSeg/Segment_${SEG}_trimmed.fa -o $TEMPDIR/eachSeg/Segment_$SEG.est -c 0.95 -n 10 -d 0 -M 500000 -T 10"
done

# make list of references
for SEG in HA MP NA NP NS PA PB1 PB2; do
  fgrep '>' $TEMPDIR/eachSeg/Segment_$SEG.est | sed 's/>//' | awk '{print $0 "\t" var}' var=$SEG
done > $TEMPDIR/ReferenceNames.txt


```
